changeinfo.changes:
• "Bakuki's Lair" is unlocked for FREE (more levels, more collectibles)
  • Swiping (and fast swiping) is more responsive and accurate.
  • Front and back taps are more precise.
  • Squeezing can be performed while swiping.
  • Earning STARS is now based on time only, rather than time and gestures.
  • New and improved helpful hints.
  • Added widescreen bars to notify when input is not allowed.
  • Stopping characters when they are close to each other is now easier.
  • Progression blocker fixes.
  • Many, many tiny bug fixes.
